fixes.explanation: Yes, baker. The text says, “Prepare a lump of pressed figs and apply it to the boil, and he will recover.” (Isaiah 38:21) That's Isaiah's exact instruction. Those figs were meant for Hezekiah's boil. Figs, friend. Just figs.
